cells.gaps: The minister's 1 per cent counts the utility's low-voltage subscribers; the World Bank's series gives 19.4 per cent for 2024.
cells.note: The latest figure, 1 per cent of rural people given by the energy minister in September 2025, is below the 27 per cent line, so stage 1. Under message 138 a figure from any source counts, not only the World Bank series.
